cases.text: Pre-auth request - policy P/181234/12/2026/004567

To the TPA desk,

Raising pre-authorisation for Mrs Lakshmi Devi, UHID 0024518.

Estimated cost: INR 85,000

They want the discharge summary and the PAN copy. PAN on record is HKPPS5875Q.

Employee UHID list is 0038001 through 0038014. Package rate applies.
Invoice to be raised against the corporate account, not the individuals.

Passport number M8234567, treated here in 2024 under UHID 0021155.
Identity verified in person. Please release the summary and the imaging CD.

Driving licence recorded at admission: MH1220110012345.
Records department to prepare a certified copy for the hearing on the 14th.

Beneficiary Harish Chandra Sethi, ABHA 96-9015-1720-1488.
Aadhaar 9552 4877 0811 seeded and verified on the scheme portal.
Package code and the discharge summary are uploaded. Awaiting approval.
ID proof alternative

The patient does not have an Aadhaar card with him today. He has produced a
voter ID, number ABC1234567, which the registration policy accepts as an
alternative. Record updated accordingly for UHID 0028830.
Form 16 correction - Dr Menon

Dr S Menon's PAN was entered incorrectly in the payroll system.
Correct PAN is GTQPJ1081D. Please reissue Form 16 for the last quarter and
confirm to finance once done.
Nursing council registration check

Verifying the nursing council registration for the new ICU hire.
Registration number 45123 was quoted on the application form.
Please confirm with the council before the joining date.
Tomorrow's OPD list

Dr Iyer's OPD tomorrow, 22 patients booked.
First four: UHID 0024518, 0031902, 0027741, 0019488.
Two are new registrations and will need extra time at the desk.
Clinic starts at 0900 as usual.
Consent for research use

Patient Zoya Ahmed, UHID 0037215, has signed the consent for her anonymised data
to be used in the diabetes registry. Contact 9701199887 if the ethics committee
needs to reach her. Original consent is filed in the records room.
TPA followup batch

Pending with the TPA:
  P/181234/12/2026/004567 - query raised, documents sent 03/06
  GHS/2026/0091823 - rejected, appeal filed
  MED/2026/114520 - approved, payment awaited
Please chase all three at the Monday call.
Death certificate issuance

Death certificate to be issued for the patient under UHID 0028830.
Aadhaar of the deceased: 9364 0224 4047.
Informant is the son; his mobile is 9812234455. Cause of death as certified by
the treating consultant. Please prepare the municipal form.
Diabetes registry extract

Attaching the quarterly extract for the diabetes registry: 412 rows with UHID,
name, age, HbA1c and last visit date. Sample rows below for the format check.
  0024518, Lakshmi Devi, 61, 7.8, 04/06/2026
  0031902, Sunita Bhatt, 55, 8.1, 02/06/2026
  0027741, Anand Prakash Joshi, 48, 9.0, 30/05/2026
Confirm the format before I send the full file.
Clinical meeting moved to room A12

The clinical governance meeting has moved to room A12 on the second floor.
Please update your calendars. The patient safety agenda is unchanged.
Vitamin B12 stock

The pharmacy is low on vitamin B12 injections. Reorder raised with the supplier.
Oral supplements remain available for the outpatient clinic.
Ward C21 deep clean

Ward C21 is closed for a deep clean on Saturday. Ward B14 will absorb the
overflow. Housekeeping has been briefed and the schedule is on the noticeboard.
Vendor invoice 12345678901234

Please process vendor invoice 12345678901234 for the linen contract.
The purchase order reference is on the second page of the attachment.
Payment confirmation

The transfer to the equipment supplier has gone through.
Transaction reference 45678912345678, value date today. Bank confirmation is
attached for the accounts file.
Stationery order HSP-2026-0012

Order HSP-2026-0012 for stationery has been delivered to the store.
Please acknowledge receipt so accounts can release the payment.
Asset tag SMH-2026-004999 retired

The old ultrasound machine, asset tag SMH-2026-004999, has been decommissioned
and removed from the register. Disposal certificate is with biomedical.
Test data in the staging system

The staging database has placeholder values like 2345 6789 0123 in the Aadhaar
column. They fail checksum validation and should be cleared before the demo.
Form defaults

Several forms were submitted with 1111 1111 1111 typed into the Aadhaar field
as a placeholder. The data entry team has been told to leave it blank instead.
Courier address correction

The courier has the wrong PIN code for the branch. It should be 560103, not
560013. Please update the address on the dispatch labels.
Budget figures for the quarter

Capital budget 9845000000 rupees against a revised estimate of 8420000000.
The variance note is with finance. Board review is on the 30th.
HIS release notes v2.14

Release v2.14 goes out this weekend. It includes fixes to the billing module
and the report scheduler. Known issue K21 in the tracker is deferred to v2.15.
Monitor model E11 quotation

The vendor has quoted for the E11 series patient monitors, twelve units.
Comparison with the J18 series from the other supplier is attached.
Audit window

The internal audit covers 01/04/2025 to 31/03/2026. Departments should keep
their registers available for that period. Sampling starts next month.
Contact for the new intranet

Queries about the new intranet should go to helpdesk@sunrisehospital.in rather
than to individual IT staff. The old alias stops working at the end of the month.
Ward B12 stock of vitamin B12 in room A12

Deliberately awkward: ward B12 needs vitamin B12 stock delivered to room A12.
Housekeeping will move the trolley after the morning round.
Serial numbers for warranty

Warranty claim needs the serial numbers: SN-4471982-KL and SN-4471983-KL.
Both units are from the same batch and failed within the warranty period.
GST filing reference

The GST return acknowledgement reference is 174829105538 for last month.
Keep it with the filing records for the annual reconciliation.
Diagnosis coding training

Refresher training on diagnosis coding for the clinical coders.
We will cover the difference between principal and secondary diagnoses, and
common errors in coding diabetes and hypertension. No live records will be used.
ABHA integration status

The ABHA integration is now live in registration. Health ID creation takes about
ninety seconds per patient. Training material is on the intranet.
Discharge summary - Mrs Lakshmi Devi - UHID 0024518

Dear Dr Rao,

Please find the discharge summary for Mrs Lakshmi Devi, admitted 12/03/2026 and
discharged today. UHID 0024518.

Diagnosis: Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycaemia (E11.65) with essential
hypertension (I10). HbA1c 9.2 on admission, 7.8 at discharge.

Aadhaar on file: 7534 7930 7460
Attendant contact: 9845012345

Regards,
Dr S Menon
Discharge - bed 412

Summary attached for Ramesh Kumar Iyer, DOB 14/08/1971, MRN: 445123.
Admitted with community acquired pneumonia (J18.9), treated with IV antibiotics
for six days. Chest X-ray at discharge shows resolving consolidation.
Follow up in OPD after 10 days.
Biochemistry results - urgent review

Dr Nair,

Results for patient Sunita Bhatt (UHID 0031902):
  Creatinine 2.4 mg/dL (was 1.6 last month)
  eGFR 28
  Potassium 5.9
  Haemoglobin 8.2

Consistent with chronic kidney disease stage 3 (N18.3). Nephrology referral raised.
Please review today.
Bed 7 overnight

Overnight the patient in bed 7 became oliguric, creatinine climbed to 3.1 and
potassium to 6.2 with peaked T waves on the monitor. Started on calcium gluconate
and insulin-dextrose, dialysis line inserted at 0400. Family counselled about
the poor prognosis. Please review on the morning round.
CT report - Anand Prakash Joshi

CT abdomen for Anand Prakash Joshi, UHID 0027741, dated 04/06/2026.

Findings: 3.2 cm hypodense lesion in segment VI of the liver with peripheral
enhancement. Differential includes metastatic deposit. Correlate clinically.

Reported by Dr K Subramanian, Reg No. 45123.
Rx for review

Patient: Meera Sundaram, 62F, UHID 0019488
Diagnosis: unspecified asthma (J45.909)

Rx:
  Budesonide/Formoterol 160/4.5 - 1 puff BD
  Montelukast 10mg - 1 OD at night
  Salbutamol MDI - PRN

Review in 4 weeks with spirometry.
Cardiology referral

Dear cardiology team,

Referring Mr Vikram Deshpande, ABHA 14-7236-8829-2226, for evaluation of chest
pain (R07.9). ECG shows T inversions in the lateral leads. Troponin negative x2.
Known hyperlipidaemia (E78.5).

He can be reached on +91 98450 12345.

Dr A Fernandes
Ortho opinion please - IP No: 2026/04512

Admitted last night after a fall. IP No: 2026/04512.
Closed fracture of the neck of the right femur (S72.001A) on plain film.
Pre-op workup underway, awaiting anaesthesia clearance.
Patient is 78 and lives alone; social work has been informed.
OT note - LSCS

Patient Priya Raghavan, UHID 0033215, underwent emergency LSCS at 0230 for foetal
distress. Full-term delivery (O80). Live male infant, 2.8 kg, Apgar 8/9.
Estimated blood loss 600 mL. Mother and baby stable, shifted to postnatal ward.
Baby's ABHA to be generated before discharge.
ICU handover - 6 patients

Bed 1 - UHID 0024518 - septic shock, on noradrenaline 0.3 mcg/kg/min, lactate 4.1
Bed 3 - UHID 0031902 - post-op day 2, stable, for step-down today
Bed 5 - UHID 0027741 - acute kidney injury (N17.9), third dialysis session today
Bed 8 - awaiting transfer from casualty

Night team please review all vasopressor weans at 0600.
Histopath - accession HP-2026-11842

Specimen: right breast lumpectomy
Accession: HP-2026-11842
Patient: Fatima Sheikh, UHID 0035120

Microscopy: invasive ductal carcinoma, grade 2, margins clear at 4 mm.
ER positive, PR positive, HER2 negative. Coded C50.911.

Discussed at the tumour board on Friday.
Follow up reminder

Patient Arjun Nambiar, ABHA 82-4451-9858-7260, is due for his three-month diabetic
review. Last HbA1c 8.4. Please call him on 9880045512 and book a slot with Dr Iyer.
His registered email is arjun.nambiar@gmail.com.
Immunisation record request

Parent has requested the immunisation record for baby Aarav Menon, UHID 0036004,
DOB 02/01/2026. Record shows BCG, OPV-0 and Hep-B at birth, then the six-week
schedule completed on time. Please issue the card.
Psychiatry liaison

Requesting psychiatry review for the patient in bed 14 with generalised anxiety
disorder (F41.9) and poor sleep since admission. No suicidal ideation elicited.
Currently on sertraline 50mg OD. Family aware and supportive.
Inter-hospital transfer - accepting?

We have a 54-year-old male, UHID 0028830, with decompensated heart failure (I50.9)
and known ischaemic heart disease (I25.10), needing a cardiology bed with
ventilator backup. Ejection fraction 22 percent on the last echo.
Can you accept? Aadhaar 7919 8193 9197 for the transfer paperwork.
Paeds ward query

The 3-year-old admitted with acute gastroenteritis (A09) is tolerating oral
rehydration well now, two wet nappies overnight, no further vomiting.
Weight back to 12.4 kg from 11.8 on admission. Likely discharge tomorrow.
Photo consent - dermatology

Patient Zoya Ahmed, UHID 0037215, has consented to clinical photography of the
atopic dermatitis (L20.9) lesions on both forearms for the teaching archive.
Consent form is scanned and on file.
Allergy alert added

Anaphylactic reaction to ceftriaxone (T78.40XA) documented for UHID 0024518.
Alert flag added to the chart and the wristband updated. Please brief the
incoming team at handover.
Eye camp follow-ups

Three patients from Saturday's camp need follow up for unspecified keratitis
(H10.9). UHIDs 0038001, 0038007 and 0038014. All were given drops and asked to
return in a week. Please confirm the appointments were made.
ANC list for Thursday

Antenatal clinic Thursday, 14 booked. Two are high risk:
  - UHID 0039112, gestational diabetes, needs a growth scan
  - UHID 0039140, previous LSCS, for consultant review
Rest are routine. Scan slots are confirmed with radiology.
RTA - police intimation done

Road traffic accident brought in at 2140, IP No: 2026/04588.
Unidentified male, approximately 30 years, head injury with GCS 9 on arrival.
Intubated in casualty, CT head shows a small extradural. Neurosurgery informed.
Police intimation completed. No relatives traced yet.
Chemo cycle 3 - dose adjustment

Patient Harish Chandra Sethi, UHID 0034411, ABHA 21-3528-1949-7011.
Neutrophils 0.9 before cycle 3, so today's dose is deferred by a week and GCSF
started. Counselled about neutropenic sepsis warning signs. Contact number on
file is 9701122334.
ABHA linking pending

The ABHA address lakshmi.devi@abdm is created but not yet linked to the hospital
record. Please complete the linkage before the discharge summary is uploaded to
the health locker.
Diet plan - renal

Renal diet plan prepared for UHID 0031902. Potassium restricted to 2 g per day,
fluid allowance 1 litre. Patient and daughter counselled. Handout given in Telugu.
Reassess at the next dialysis session.
Physio discharge note

Post-operative rehab completed for the patient with low back pain (M54.50).
Independently mobile with a stick, stairs assessed and safe. Home exercise
programme issued. No further physiotherapy input needed.

COVID diagnosis
Confirmed diagnosis U07.1, patient isolated on ward 3.
Post COVID-19 condition coded U09.9 for the discharge summary.
Injury diagnosis V01.00, pedestrian struck, admitted overnight.
Nursing duty roster - week of 8 June

Morning shift: Anitha, Rekha, Joseph
Evening shift: Fatima, Ganesh, Priyanka
Night shift: Sudha, Mohan

Swaps need my approval by Friday. Leave requests go through the portal, not email.
Mortality and morbidity meeting - Thursday 1600

The M&M meeting is moved to Thursday at 1600 in the third floor seminar room.
Please bring your department's aggregate numbers only - no patient identifiers
on the slides. IT will set up the projector by 1545.
Quotation required - infusion pumps

We need quotations for 12 volumetric infusion pumps for the new ICU wing.
Please include AMC terms for three years and delivery timelines.
Send quotes to the purchase department before the 20th.
Scheduled downtime - HIS

The hospital information system will be down on Sunday from 0200 to 0500 for a
database upgrade. Use the paper fallback forms during that window and enter the
data once the system is back. Casualty will have a standby terminal.
BLS recertification - slots open

Basic life support recertification runs on the 12th and the 19th.
Twenty slots per session, first come first served. Certificates are valid for
two years. Register with the education cell.
Water supply interruption - B block

Maintenance will interrupt the water supply to B block on Wednesday between
1000 and 1300 to replace a valve. Wards on that riser have been informed and
storage tanks are full. Theatres are unaffected.
Stock shortage - injectable iron

We are down to eleven vials of injectable iron sucrose. The supplier has quoted
a two week lead time. Please restrict to inpatients until the stock arrives and
use the oral formulation in OPD where clinically acceptable.
NABH audit prep - aggregate indicators

Indicator summary for the quarter:
  Hand hygiene compliance 84 percent
  Surgical site infection rate 1.2 percent
  Average length of stay 4.1 days
  Readmission within 30 days 6.8 percent
No case level detail in this mail - the auditors will sample from the system.
Holiday list 2027

The declared holiday list for next year is attached. Twelve gazetted holidays
plus two restricted holidays of your choice. Departments running 24x7 should
plan cover as usual and submit rosters a month in advance.
Cafeteria timings during renovation

The main cafeteria closes at 2000 during the renovation. The night canteen near
casualty stays open. Vending machines on floors 2 and 4 have been restocked.
Ventilator preventive maintenance due

Preventive maintenance is due on six ventilators this month. The vendor engineer
will be on site Tuesday and Wednesday. Please release units in pairs so ICU
capacity is not affected. Service reports go to biomedical.
Revised consent policy - effective 1 July

The consent policy has been revised to require a witness signature for all
high risk procedures. Updated forms are in the shared drive. Departments should
destroy the old stock of printed forms after the changeover date.
CME - antimicrobial stewardship

Guest lecture on antimicrobial stewardship this Saturday at 1100 in the
auditorium. Two credit hours. The speaker will cover carbapenem sparing
strategies and the local antibiogram. Open to all clinical staff.
Payment terms clarification

Our standard payment terms are 45 days from invoice receipt, not 30 as stated
in your draft agreement. Please revise clause 7 and resend for signature.
Accounts will confirm the vendor onboarding separately.
Phishing attempt - do not click

Several staff have received a mail claiming to be from the payroll department
asking them to re-enter bank details. It is not from us. Do not click the link.
Forward it to IT security and delete it.
Ethics committee agenda

Four protocols are up for review at the next ethics committee meeting.
Two are observational, one is a device trial and one is a retrospective chart
review. Members will get the anonymised protocol packs three days in advance.
Blood donation camp - volunteers needed

The voluntary donation camp is on the 26th in the OPD forecourt.
We need six volunteers for registration and refreshments. Target is 80 units.
Sign up on the sheet outside the blood bank.
Staff parking passes - renewal

Parking passes expire at the end of the month. Renewal is through the admin
office with your employee card. The visitor bays near the entrance are not to
be used by staff at any time.
Fire drill Thursday 1500

A fire drill is scheduled for Thursday at 1500. Wards should demonstrate the
horizontal evacuation route without moving actual patients. Marshals will be
in yellow vests. The alarm will sound for two minutes.
New signage installed

New wayfinding signage is up across the ground floor. The radiology arrow near
the lifts is wrong and will be corrected on Monday. Report any other errors to
the facilities helpdesk.
